about_the_game:
Get ready to feel the power of third-person vehicular combat with this demo. You’re not here just to race — you’re here to shoot, dodge, and survive among sand-covered ruins and twisted metal.

What’s included in this demo?

  • Full shooting and tactical driving system: control a battle car with mounted weapons, feel the recoil, and dominate the terrain.

  • Selected environments set in ancient temples and desert canyons, with intense and strategic combat.

  • Varied enemies: test your aim against hostile golems.

This demo is just a taste of the full world of Guns on Wheels, but it’s enough to experience its essence: brutal battles, action on wheels, and landscapes that tell ancient stories.
Are you ready to roar in the desert?

short_description: Playable demo of Guns on Wheels: third-person combat on armed vehicles, selected desert environments, mechanical enemies, and basic customization. Feel the action and survive the dust!
